name: Omnipotent Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2016, Omnipotent Industries Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and trading Bitumen and Other Similar Bitumen supplements[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) OIL specializes in the import and sale of bulk and packaged bitumen, bitumen emulsions, special bituminous allied products, and other bituminous materials across India. 
b) The company provides Bitumen (Asphalt) solutions for traders, importers, and manufacturers, catering to road construction and industrial usage. 
c) It leases storage tanks and bulk 
bitumen from Mundra & Karwar, while packed drum bitumen is sourced from JNPT, Mumbai, 
Haldia & Kolkata. 
d) It has formed 11 joint ventures and 2 branches across India
e) The company is India’s only consultant providing end-to-end project management services, from site identification to plant handover with certifications.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.19 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -16.6% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -6.69% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 311 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -28.4%
